hero.lead: Moderation, welcomes, scheduled posts and fun for your group, all set up from one simple panel.

moderation.title: Moderation and anti-spam
moderation.body: Filters and rules that keep the group clean without extra work for admins.

welcome.title: Welcome and captcha
welcome.body: Greet new members and make sure they are real people.

schedule.title: Scheduled posts
schedule.body: Queue announcements and recurring messages to go out at the right time.

events.title: Events
events.body: Create events, collect RSVPs and remind everyone.

memes.title: Memes and image search
memes.body: Commands like /meme and /searchimage to liven up the chat.

ai.title: AI chat
ai.body: Talk to Cookiebot and ask for help right in the group.

add.title: Add it to your group
add.body: Use the Invite Me! button and pick your group in Telegram.

admin.title: Make it an admin
admin.body: Give Cookiebot permission to moderate and send messages.

configure.title: Configure it
configure.body: Tune everything in the web panel or the Mini App, no commands to memorise.

final.title: Ready for a crispier group?
final.body: Add Cookiebot in seconds and set it up your way.
